findings.description: The loop now removes only param.opts from the help option names and no longer removes param.secondary_opts, which the old code did.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command has a boolean option such as @click.option('--verbose/--help') whose secondary opt '--help' is reserved. Before this change, '--help' was removed from the candidate help names, so no conflicting help option was created. After it, '--help' stays in the candidates and the help option is added with that name, colliding with the secondary flag. Impact: the command gets a duplicate or shadowed --help, and users can no longer reach the intended behavior through that name.
